# Legacy aquarium regression fixtures

Test-only snapshots of the retired aquarium12 gallery. These are not registered
in the runtime map project or model browser.

The single GLB preserves glass, authored vertex-color, and animation-loader
coverage. The navigation exports and catalog snapshot preserve simulation and
navigation tests. The OWMAP preserves model-placement and floor-cutout decoder
coverage; its original model path strings are intentionally retained as data,
not resolvable runtime assets. Shared Pokémon assets still resolve from the real
project root.
